_meta.calibration_note: Framework channel CACs are USD/Western-calibrated; India anchors reused from v1 cac.json (Linkrunner 2026: median India CPI ~INR 20, EdTech ~INR 68). Organic effective CAC = founder time at an assumed INR 500/hr / estimated installs. All yields are ESTIMATES. Free tier assumed ad-free (per idea: no upsell, quiet).

ltv_assumptions: Payer mix 50/50: annual INR 199 (net ~INR 169 after Play 15%) with 30% renewal -> ~INR 220 lifetime; season pass INR 49 (net ~INR 42) bought ~1.7x -> ~INR 71. Average ~INR 145 per payer
Pro messaging cost (WhatsApp utility ~INR 0.12-0.15, SMS ~INR 0.10-0.25) ~INR 13 per payer lifetime -> net ~INR 132 per payer
LTV per install = 1.2% x INR 132 = ~INR 1.6. Optimistic (3% conversion + Form Check bundled raising payer value to ~INR 170) = ~INR 5.1
Lifespan 5 months: D30 10% -> framework band 3-6 months; ARPU = 1.6 / 5 = INR 0.32/mo

v1 LTV was INR 4.5 but ~90% of it came from ads (INR ~1/active month). Removing ads to honour the 'quiet' promise means v2's BASE LTV is LOWER than v1's, despite a better paid tier. Sensitivity: adding light ads back (~INR 1/active month) -> ~INR 6.6, but breaks positioning
Data-ops cost not in LTV: est. 15-50 founder hours/month to curate central + one state's notifications (see market_insights pro-tier-economics §5)

founder_budget_tier_rationale: No user_profile.md; solo indie, no audience -> Bootstrap assumed ($0-100/mo). Paid channels modelled but excluded from recommendation.

aso_organic.assumption: Same as v1: 20 hrs/mo -> ~1,000 installs/mo after ramp (estimate)

content_seo.assumption: Per-notification eligibility pages; 3-6 month lag; SERPs owned by aggregators/edtechs

tiktok_organic.assumption: TikTok banned in India -> modelled as founder-made Shorts/Reels

reddit_community.assumption: Reddit irrelevant; modelled as Telegram/WhatsApp aspirant-group seeding, 15 hrs/mo -> ~1,900 installs/mo (estimate)

paid_social_meta.assumption: Between India median CPI INR 20 and EdTech INR 68

word_of_mouth.assumption: Share card + family mode; k ~0.14 caps volume at ~14% on top of other channels

skipped_channels: paid_social_meta, influencer excluded from recommendation (Bootstrap) but modelled
recommended_first_channel: Telegram/WhatsApp aspirant-group seeding with a free eligibility checker + share cards (RAT vehicle only)
recommended_first_channel_rationale: Best ratio among channels a Bootstrap solo dev can run; still far below 2:1. Recommended only to run the WTP test, not as a growth plan.
break_even_math: To reach 3:1 on Telegram seeding (CAC INR 4) LTV must be ~INR 12 = 7.5x the base case: e.g. ~6% of installs paying ~INR 200 lifetime, or ~10-15% of 'applied' users buying a INR 49 season pass with a bundled Form Check. On ASO (INR 10) LTV must be ~INR 30 (19x).
market_insights_adjustments: Incumbents fund SEO/YouTube/Telegram funnels -> organic CAC kept at v1 levels
pro-tier-economics: Truecaller India sub-1% paid share, RevenueCat India ~0.7% -> conversion capped at 1.2% base
pro-tier-economics: WhatsApp utility ~INR 0.12-0.15/msg -> Pro margin ~88-95% after messaging
pro-tier-economics: UPI AutoPay low-balance revocations -> renewal kept at 30%
viability_verdict_rationale: No channel reaches 1:1 in the base case; only volume-capped word-of-mouth exceeds 2:1 even in the optimistic case. Root cause unchanged from v1: LTV, not CAC. The refinement makes the paid tier more coherent but, by removing ads, lowers base LTV from ~INR 4.5 to ~INR 1.6 per install. Viability requires a measured paid conversion several times above Indian norms.
